SELECT g.id AS goods_id, gi.image_url AS goods_image, g.send AS send, g.price AS goods_price, g.desc AS goods_description, g.state AS state, u.account AS user_account, u.head_url AS user_avatar, gh.look_num, gh.want_num FROM goods g JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, MIN(image_order) AS min_image_order FROM goods_images GROUP BY goods_id ) sub ON g.id = sub.goods_id JOIN goods_images gi ON g.id = gi.goods_id AND sub.min_image_order = gi.image_order JOIN user u ON g.seller = u.id JOIN goods_hot gh ON gh.goods_id=g.id
where g.desc like #{text}
